events.description:
Coffee & Code Philly
# Coffee & Code West Chester: Community Coworking Day

Coffee & Code Philadelphia is coming to West Chester for a full day of coworking, building, and meeting people from across the local technology community.
Join us at Turks Head Coffee Roasters anytime between 6:30 AM and 5:00 PM. Bring your laptop, grab some coffee, and spend the day working alongside software engineers, founders, students, designers, technology professionals, and other local builders.
This is a relaxed, drop-in event. You are welcome to stay for an hour, work through the afternoon, or join us for most of the day.

## What to expect

* Open coworking throughout the day
* Informal networking with local technology professionals
* Opportunities to meet potential collaborators, mentors, and community organizers
* Conversations about future workshops, technical events, and hackathons in the western suburbs
* A chance to help shape a recurring Coffee & Code series in West Chester

We are also exploring ways to collaborate with Philly Tech Exchange and other regional technology groups to strengthen connections between local workers, employers, mentors, mentees, and community organizers.
There is no formal presentation or required arrival time. Just bring your laptop and something you would like to work on.

events.title: Career Discussion for IT Professionals
events.description:
Coffee & Code Philly
This is a recurring session for IT professionals to discuss career growth and market strategy. We focus on how to build rare and valuable skills, improve professional standing, and navigate the current job market.

**The Format:**

* **The Concept (5 mins):** One core idea regarding professional development or career strategy.
* **The Discussion (30 mins):** The floor opens for group feedback. We share real-world experiences and peer advice to help everyone improve their career capital.
* **The Next Idea (5 mins):** Voting for the next core idea to discuss.

**Why Join?** The goal is to move beyond just writing code. We talk about what actually works in the industry right now, from technical positioning to performing better in your current role.

**Join us to share your perspective and hear how others are navigating their career paths.**
